topic: Finding the volume of a moving crate
core_question: A moving crate measures 10 inches by 8 inches by 6 inches. What is its volume in cubic inches? (secondary: A $47 restaurant bill is split evenly among 4 friends. How much does each person pay?)
answer_summary: 480 cubic inches (10 in by 8 in by 6 in crate); after the topic shift: $11.75 per person ($47 split four ways)
